preconditions.description: The graph has between 4 and 5000 vertices, and between n and 3n edges. It is connected, with each edge part of a cycle of length no more than 5.
Each vertex has at most 3 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(len(find_cycle(graph, e)) <= 5 for e in edges(graph))
preconditions.description: Each edge is part of a cycle of length no more than 5.

postconditions.expression: any(bees[i] == nastya for i in range(3))
postconditions.description: The bees win if at any point they are all at the same vertex as Nastya.

postconditions.expression: all(bees[i] != nastya for i in range(3))
postconditions.description: The bees lose if after n moves Nastya is not at the same vertex as any bee.
